component.name: Dialga
component.summary: Import and export SQL Server databases on Amazon RDS via S3

description.p: Dialga imports and exports Microsoft SQL Server databases on Amazon RDS through S3, with the native backup and restore of RDS, pre-flight checks, a dry run that shows the exact T-SQL, and a journal of every operation. It ships a desktop app and the dialga command line tool.

ul.li: Restore and export databases, also many at once as one job
Restore over an existing database, keeping the old one or a backup
Integrated SSM tunnel to the instance, with verified TLS
Database access: grant, revoke and fix orphan users
